plan: With a private value of $39, I want to maximize potential profit. Since this is a second-price sealed bid auction, my optimal strategy is to bid close to my true value. Other bidders are rational and likely to bid strategically. I'll bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer - this protects against overpaying while still having a strong chance of winning. A bid around $35-$37 seems strategically sound.
